cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Confess First
cards.instruction: Get someone else to confess or incriminate themselves before you reveal anything.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Before we plan Mum's apology dinner, why did she spend her birthday outside the restaurant? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I forgot the booking. What happened to her present?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Did you forget, or assume I'd book it?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I assumed you'd do it. Now your turn.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Even after telling Mum it was confirmed? Give me that bit, then you get the present.

mechanism: A confidently manages the order of reciprocal disclosure while conceding location, wording or process to keep B talking first and A own information withheld.
confusable: Distinguish D232 partial confession reciprocity from giving no own admission before extracting B incriminating detail; S02 must actually accommodate resistance.
comparison: Office printer/kitchen problems negotiate inquiry order; family booking/present problems negotiate a supposedly shared account.
seedUse: Canonical printer and apology-dinner seeds supply competing disclosures; preserve A withheld role while replacing generic charge with practical cooperation concessions.
